<section class="ts-intro">

<div class="ts-intro__head">

<h2 class="ts-heading">Why Vietnam?</h2>
<p class="ts-copy">Vietnam is the perfect choice for those who want to kitesurf in warm water during winter while discovering a completely different culture, amazing food and beautiful tropical landscapes.</p>
</div>
<div class="ts-why-grid">
<div class="ts-feature">
<div class="ts-feature__icon">💨</div>
<h3>Reliable wind</h3>
<p>Vietnam’s southern coastline is one of Asia’s best-known kitesurf regions during the winter months.</p>
</div>
<div class="ts-feature">
<div class="ts-feature__icon">🌴</div>
<h3>Tropical setting</h3>
<p>Palm trees, sandy beaches, warm sea and daytime temperatures around 30°C.</p>
</div>
<div class="ts-feature">
<div class="ts-feature__icon">🌊</div>
<h3>Two completely different spots</h3>
<p>Mui Ne’s wave conditions are complemented by Phan Rang’s flat-water lagoon.</p>
</div>
<div class="ts-feature">
<div class="ts-feature__icon">🚐</div>
<h3>Fully organized trip</h3>
<p>Accommodation, local transfers, kite programs and tour leadership in one package.</p>
</div>
</div>
</div>

<h2 class="ts-heading">Mui Ne + Phan Rang</h2>
<p class="ts-copy">The trip combines two kitesurf destinations with very different characters, giving you a much more varied experience on the water within a single journey.</p>

<section id="mui-ne" class="ts-destination">
<div class="ts-container">
<div class="ts-destination__grid">
<div class="ts-destination__media">
<div class="ts-destination__image"><img loading="lazy" alt="Mui Ne kitesurf" src="https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/0556/6811/3598/files/20251220_172015.jpg?v=1788877845"></div>
<div class="ts-destination__floating">
<strong>Vietnam’s classic kite town</strong> <span> Beach life, kitesurfing, surfing, restaurants and tropical vibes all in one place. </span>
</div>
</div>
<div>
<div class="ts-eyebrow">First destination</div>
<h2 class="ts-heading">Mui Ne</h2>
<p class="ts-copy">Mui Ne is one of Vietnam’s best-known beach destinations, with a long sandy beach lined with palm trees. It has been popular with kitesurfers for decades thanks to its regular winds and easily accessible spots.</p>
<p class="ts-copy">Besides kitesurfing, there are opportunities for surfing, relaxing on the beach and joining various excursions. In the evenings, restaurants, beach bars and Mui Ne’s laid-back surf atmosphere await.</p>
<div class="ts-destination__facts">
<div class="ts-fact">
<strong>🌊 Waves</strong> <span>Wave riding and surfing.</span>
</div>
<div class="ts-fact">
<strong>🪁 Downwind</strong> <span>Longer downwind kite trips along the coast.</span>
</div>
<div class="ts-fact">
<strong>🌴 Beach life</strong> <span>Palm trees, sandy beaches and tropical vibes.</span>
</div>
<div class="ts-fact">
<strong>🍜 Local life</strong> <span>Restaurants, shops and local markets.</span>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</section>

<section class="ts-hotel">
<div class="ts-container">
<div class="ts-hotel__head">
<div class="ts-eyebrow">Accommodation · Mui Ne</div>
<h2 class="ts-heading">Right on the beach</h2>
<p class="ts-copy">The hotel is located on Mui Ne’s central white-sand beach, approximately 500 metres from the kitesurf school.</p>
</div>
<div class="ts-hotel__layout">
<div class="ts-hotel__main"><img loading="lazy" alt="Mui Ne tengerparti hotel" src="https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/0556/6811/3598/files/222043506.jpg?v=1751794849"></div>

<div class="ts-hotel__info">
<h3>Everything you need after a day of kitesurfing</h3>
<p>A large outdoor pool, open-air restaurant, air-conditioned rooms and a private balcony or terrace. Garden-view and sea-view rooms are also available.</p>
<div class="ts-hotel__amenities">
<div class="ts-hotel__amenity">🏖️ Beachfront</div>

<section id="phan-rang" class="ts-phanrang">
<div class="ts-container">
<div class="ts-phanrang__grid">
<div>
<div class="ts-eyebrow">Second destination</div>
<h2 class="ts-heading">Phan Rang</h2>
<p class="ts-copy">Phan Rang is the more performance-focused destination of the tour. Strong, reliable wind and a huge flat-water lagoon make it excellent for freeride, freestyle and improving your technique.</p>
<p class="ts-copy">Around 300 metres offshore, waves break on the outer reef, so you can enjoy both flat water and wave riding at the same spot.</p>
<div class="ts-phanrang__stats">
<div class="ts-phanrang__stat">
<strong>20–30 kn</strong> <span>typical wind</span>
</div>
<div class="ts-phanrang__stat">
<strong>~30°C</strong> <span>daytime temperature</span>
</div>
<div class="ts-phanrang__stat">
<strong>~300 m</strong> <span>outer reef</span>
</div>
</div>
<div class="ts-phanrang__bullets">
<div class="ts-phanrang__bullet">
<span class="ts-phanrang__check">✓</span> Glassy flat-water lagoon</div>
<div class="ts-phanrang__bullet">
<span class="ts-phanrang__check">✓</span> Wave riding a outer reefen</div>
<div class="ts-phanrang__bullet">
<span class="ts-phanrang__check">✓</span> Downwinders</div>
<div class="ts-phanrang__bullet">
<span class="ts-phanrang__check">✓</span> Strong, performance-oriented conditions</div>
</div>
</div>

<section id="program" class="ts-itinerary">
<div class="ts-container">
<div class="ts-itinerary__head">
<div class="ts-eyebrow">14 days in Vietnam</div>
<h2 class="ts-heading">Tour itinerary</h2>
<p class="ts-copy">Two kite regions, organized transfers, group activities and enough free time to enjoy Vietnam at your own pace.</p>
</div>
<div class="ts-itinerary__timeline">
<div class="ts-itinerary__item">
<div class="ts-itinerary__marker">01</div>
<div class="ts-itinerary__card">
<div class="ts-itinerary__phase">Arrival</div>
<h3>Ho Chi Minh City → Mui Ne</h3>
<div class="ts-itinerary__duration">Day 1</div>
<div class="qMYqUG_convSearchResultHighlightRoot qMYqUG_convSearchResultTextHighlightSafari">
<div class="">
<section class="text-token-text-primary w-full focus:outline-none has-data-writing-block:pointer-events-none [&amp;:has([data-writing-block])&gt;*]:pointer-events-auto R6Vx5W_threadScrollVars scroll-mb-[calc(var(--scroll-root-safe-area-inset-bottom,0px)+var(--thread-response-height))] scroll-mt-[calc(var(--header-height)+min(200px,max(70px,20svh)))]" dir="auto">
<div class="text-base my-auto mx-auto pb-8 [--thread-content-margin:var(--thread-content-margin-xs,calc(var(--spacing)*4))] @w-sm/main:[--thread-content-margin:var(--thread-content-margin-sm,calc(var(--spacing)*6))] @w-lg/main:[--thread-content-margin:var(--thread-content-margin-lg,calc(var(--spacing)*16))] px-(--thread-content-margin)">
<div class="[--thread-content-max-width:40rem] @w-lg/main:[--thread-content-max-width:48rem] mx-auto max-w-(--thread-content-max-width) flex-1 group/turn-messages focus-visible:outline-hidden relative flex w-full min-w-0 flex-col agent-turn">
<div class="flex max-w-full flex-col gap-4 grow">
<div dir="auto" class="min-h-8 text-message relative flex w-full flex-col items-end gap-2 text-start break-words whitespace-normal outline-none keyboard-focused:focus-ring [.text-message+&amp;]:mt-1">
<div class="flex w-full flex-col gap-1 empty:hidden">
<div class="LR5Y_W_content safari-katex-mathml markdown prose dark:prose-invert wrap-break-word w-full dark markdown-new-styling">
<p dir="auto" class="PDq2pG_selectionAnchorContainer">Arrival at Ho Chi Minh City Airport, meeting with the group, followed by a private transfer to Mui Ne.<span class="PDq2pG_selectionAnchor"></span></p>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</section>
</div>
</div>
<p>The journey takes approximately 3 hours. After arrival, we’ll check in at the hotel, relax, and have dinner together.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="ts-itinerary__item">
<div class="ts-itinerary__marker">02</div>
<div class="ts-itinerary__card">
<div class="ts-itinerary__phase">Mui Ne</div>
<h3>7 days of kitesurfing &amp; beach life</h3>
<div class="ts-itinerary__duration">First week</div>
<p>Kitesurfing is the main focus of the following days. Depending on the wind conditions, participants can enjoy kite sessions, downwinders, wave riding and coaching sessions.</p>
<p>On windless days, you can surf, explore the area, discover local restaurants or simply relax on the beach.</p>
<div class="ts-itinerary__optional">Optional activities: sand dunes, Mekong Delta, local markets and temples.</div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="ts-itinerary__item">
<div class="ts-itinerary__marker">03</div>
<div class="ts-itinerary__card ts-itinerary__card--dark">
<div class="ts-itinerary__phase">Included in the price</div>
<h3>Ta Cu Mountain</h3>
<div class="ts-itinerary__duration">Group excursion</div>
<p>Excursion to Ta Cu Mountain, where we take the cable car up the mountain. During the trip, we explore Buddhist temples and unique Vietnamese landscapes.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="ts-itinerary__item">
<div class="ts-itinerary__marker">04</div>
<div class="ts-itinerary__card">
<div class="ts-itinerary__phase">On the road</div>
<h3>Mui Ne → Phan Rang</h3>
<div class="ts-itinerary__duration">approx. 2.5 hours</div>
<p>After our week in Mui Ne, we continue by private transfer to the Phan Rang area.</p>

<div class="ts-faq__list">
<details open="">
<summary>Can I join as a beginner?</summary>
<div class="ts-faq__answer">Yes. Beginners are welcome to join the tour. Beginner kitesurf lessons can be booked separately, and all equipment is included in the lesson price. </div>
</details>
<details open="">
<summary>Do I need to bring my own kitesurf equipment?</summary>
<div class="ts-faq__answer">Kitesurf equipment rental is available at both spots. All equipment is included when you book lessons. </div>
</details>
<details open="">
<summary>What wind conditions can we expect?</summary>
<div class="ts-faq__answer">
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<p>The winter months are the classic kite season in southern Vietnam. In Phan Rang, stronger winds around 20–30 knots are common, while conditions in Mui Ne can be more variable.</p>
</div>
</details>
<details open="">
<summary>What happens if there is no wind?</summary>
<div class="ts-faq__answer">The program is flexible. On windless days, you can choose from surfing, excursions, beach time, sightseeing and other local activities.</div>
</details>
<details open="">
<summary>Are international flights included in the price?</summary>
<div class="ts-faq__answer">No. Each participant books their own international flights to and from Ho Chi Minh City.</div>
</details>
<details open="">
<summary>Can I join on my own?</summary>
<div class="ts-faq__answer">Absolutely. You can choose a private room or request shared accommodation.</div>
</details>
<details open="">
<summary>Do I need separate sports insurance?</summary>
<div class="ts-faq__answer">We strongly recommend travel insurance that covers kitesurfing and any other sports activities you plan to take part in.</div>
</details>
<details open="">
<summary>How can I book?</summary>
<div class="ts-faq__answer">Email daniel@true-surfers.com or send a WhatsApp message to +36 30 683 3972.</div>
</details>
</div>
</div>
</section>

<div class="ts-container">
<div class="ts-final__inner">

<p class="ts-final__text">Mui Ne, Phan Rang, tropical beaches, warm water, reliable wind and a shared True Surfers adventure.</p>
